evals.name: metadata-first-then-filtered-csv
evals.prompt: Pull the data behind https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/share-electricity-renewables for Germany, France and Spain from 2010 onwards. Save it to data/renewables.csv and tell me what the values actually measure.
evals.expected_output: A saved CSV containing only DEU, FRA and ESB rows from 2010 onwards, plus a plain-language description of the indicator and its unit taken from the metadata.
assertions: The metadata JSON was fetched before the CSV
The CSV request used csvType=filtered with a country filter rather than downloading every country
The saved file contains only the three requested countries
The saved file contains no years before 2010
The stated unit matches the unit field in the metadata
The full CSV contents were not printed into the response

evals.name: surface-data-caveats
evals.prompt: My editor wants a footnote about the limitations of this data before we publish: https://ourworldindata.org/grapher/annual-co2-emissions-per-country. What should it say?
evals.expected_output: A footnote grounded in the chart's descriptionKey and descriptionProcessing fields — e.g. that emissions are territorial and exclude international aviation and shipping — plus the citation.
assertions: The response draws on descriptionKey entries from the metadata rather than general knowledge about CO2 accounting
The citation from the metadata is included
Any caveat stated can be traced to a field in the metadata response

evals.name: token-discipline-on-a-large-chart
evals.prompt: I need life expectancy for every country in 2021 from ourworldindata.org/grapher/life-expectancy, ranked highest to lowest, top 10 and bottom 10.
evals.expected_output: Two ranked lists of ten countries each, produced without reading the whole global CSV into context.
assertions: The data was filtered server-side with the time parameter or processed with a tool (jq, duckdb, sort) rather than pasted into the response
The response contains exactly the top 10 and bottom 10, not the full country list
Aggregates such as World or continent rows are excluded from the country rankings, or their exclusion is stated
